error.title: Cycle data didn’t load
error.message: Check your connection and try again.

contributedEth.label: Contributed ETH
contributedEth.tooltip: Direct ETH contributions from the community this cycle.

attachedNfts.label: Attached NFTs
attachedNfts.tooltip: NFTs attached to gestures by the community this cycle.

signature.name: Signature Allocation
signature.tooltip: After the countdown reaches zero, the participant who made the Final Gesture may finalize the cycle and retrieve this allocation: ETH, 1,000 CST, a Cosmic Signature NFT, and attached tokens.

chronoWarrior.name: Chrono-Warrior Allocation
chronoWarrior.tooltip: The participant who held the Endurance Champion position for the longest consecutive interval receives a percentage of the Cycle Reserve in ETH, 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

ethStellar.name: ETH Stellar Selection
ethStellar.tooltip: Participants are selected at random from the cycle entries to share an allocation of ETH.

cosmicAnchor.name: Anchor Distribution
cosmicAnchor.tooltip: A share of the Cycle Reserve in ETH, split equally among all anchored Cosmic Signature NFTs at finalization.

publicGoods.name: Public Goods
publicGoods.tooltip: {percent}% of every Cycle Reserve is forwarded to Protocol Guild, the funding mechanism for 170+ Ethereum core contributors.

nftStellar.name: NFT Stellar Selection
nftStellar.tooltip: Participants are selected at random from the cycle entries to receive Recognition CST and Cosmic Signature NFTs.

randomWalkAnchor.name: Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection
randomWalkAnchor.tooltip: Anchor-holders of Random Walk NFTs may receive Recognition CST and Cosmic Signature NFTs.

endurance.name: Endurance Champion
endurance.tooltip: The participant who remained the most recent gesture maker for the longest consecutive interval. Receives a Recognition CST imprint of 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

finalCst.name: Final CST Gesture
finalCst.tooltip: The participant who made the last CST gesture of the cycle receives a Recognition CST imprint of 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

allocations.title: Allocation breakdown
allocations.description: How the Cycle Reserve distributes across allocation tracks: Signature Allocation, Chrono-Warrior, Stellar Selection, Public Goods, Anchor Distribution, and the Compounding Cycle Reserve.

stellarSelectionEntries.title: Stellar Selection entries
stellarSelectionEntries.tooltip: Each gesture adds one entry to this cycle’s Stellar Selection pool, and every selection at finalization is drawn from the whole pool, with replacement. The table shows each participant’s share of the pool.

topEthSpenders.title: Top ETH spenders
topEthSpenders.tooltip: Participant addresses ranked by total ETH spent on gestures this cycle.

enduranceChampions.title: Endurance Champions
enduranceChampions.tooltip: Participants ranked by how long they remained the most-recent gesture maker. The one with the longest consecutive interval receives a Recognition CST imprint of 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

gestureHistory.title: Gesture history
gestureHistory.tooltip: Chronological record of every gesture made in this cycle, newest first.

ethContributions.title: ETH contributions
ethContributions.tooltip: Direct ETH contributions made by community members during this cycle.

cycleRules.title: Cycle rules
cycleRules.tooltip: Key rules and allocation mechanics for this cycle.

rules.participation: When you gesture, you may imprint dynamic Participation CST. The amount uses a square-root formula based on how long it has been since the previous gesture.
rules.calibration: ETH gestures shorten the CST Calibration Window by about {decreasePercent}%; CST gestures lengthen it by about {increasePercent}%.
rules.stellarSelection: Each gesture records one Stellar Selection entry. {ethEntries} entries receive {rafflePercent}% of the Cycle Reserve. {nftEntries} additional Selection recipients and {anchorHolders} Random Walk NFT anchor-holders receive a Cosmic Signature NFT.
rules.publicGoods: Protocol Guild receives {percent}% of the Cycle Reserve (at least {amount} ETH) each cycle.

attachedTokens.title: Attached tokens
attachedTokens.tooltip: NFTs and ERC-20 tokens attached to gestures for the cycle’s allocation recipient.

description.nftOnly: Assets the community attaches travel with the Signature Allocation. The Final Gesture participant receives {nftCount, plural, one {the attached NFT} other {all {nftCount} attached NFTs}} when Cycle #{cycle} finalizes.
description.erc20Only: Assets the community attaches travel with the Signature Allocation. The Final Gesture participant receives {erc20Count, plural, one {the attached ERC-20 token deposit} other {all {erc20Count} attached ERC-20 token deposits}} when Cycle #{cycle} finalizes.
description.mixed: Assets the community attaches travel with the Signature Allocation. The Final Gesture participant receives {nftCount, plural, one {the attached NFT} other {all {nftCount} attached NFTs}} and {erc20Count, plural, one {the attached ERC-20 token deposit} other {all {erc20Count} attached ERC-20 token deposits}} when Cycle #{cycle} finalizes.

bonusReceipt.nftOnly: {nftCount, plural, one {{nftCount} ERC-721 token} other {{nftCount} ERC-721 tokens}}
bonusReceipt.erc20Only: {erc20Count, plural, one {{erc20Count} ERC-20 deposit} other {{erc20Count} ERC-20 deposits}}
bonusReceipt.mixed: {nftCount, plural, one {{nftCount} ERC-721 token} other {{nftCount} ERC-721 tokens}} + {erc20Count, plural, one {{erc20Count} ERC-20 deposit} other {{erc20Count} ERC-20 deposits}}

remainder.nftOnly: Showing the featured receipt preview. Plus {nftCount, plural, one {{nftCount} more attached NFT} other {{nftCount} more attached NFTs}} in the full cycle details.
remainder.erc20Only: Showing the featured receipt preview. Plus {erc20Count, plural, one {{erc20Count} more attached ERC-20 token deposit} other {{erc20Count} more attached ERC-20 token deposits}} in the full cycle details.
remainder.mixed: Showing the featured receipt preview. Plus {nftCount, plural, one {{nftCount} more attached NFT} other {{nftCount} more attached NFTs}} and {erc20Count, plural, one {{erc20Count} more attached ERC-20 token deposit} other {{erc20Count} more attached ERC-20 token deposits}} in the full cycle details.

nftCard.floorTooltip: Collection floor estimate, not an appraisal of this specific token.
nftCard.metadataUnavailable: Metadata unavailable. The attached NFT is still part of this cycle allocation.

erc20Card.badgeTooltipLogo: Logo from {source}; verify the token address before assigning value.
erc20Card.badgeTooltipDefault: This ERC-20 token deposit is attached to the cycle and goes to the Signature Allocation recipient when finalized.
